blockers.title: Docker execution unavailable
blockers.unblock: Use a Docker-enabled local machine or authorised CI/CodeBuild runner; retain build/run logs.

blockers.title: AWS deployment access unavailable
blockers.evidence: AWS CLI absent; no AWS auth source detected; plugin discovery found analytics functionality, not an infrastructure deployment connection.
blockers.unblock: Establish a scoped, authorised AWS deployment context and verify account, role, Region and permitted actions. No credentials in chat.

blockers.title: Application-level live source path has not passed
blockers.evidence: CLI returned 44 formats with system CA trust; actual application request returned 502 source-restriction error. Full real file transfer is unverified.
blockers.unblock: Investigate supported app/runtime behaviour, then pass controlled source-to-worker-to-device tests with authorised media and the actual AWS image/network. Preserve failure details; do not treat a fixture as proof.

blockers.title: Native PostgreSQL execution requires another runtime
blockers.evidence: Schema/repository implemented and PGlite SQL/HTTP tests passed. Native binaries installed; root-only UID namespace prevents non-root initdb execution (chown EINVAL). No native concurrency/TLS target supplied.
blockers.unblock: Run the provided native suite in a mapped non-root environment or with a disposable TEST_DATABASE_URL. Preserve the single-backend/native distinction.
blockers.owner: Docker/non-root runner or disposable database context

blockers.title: Payment provider and live-test prerequisites absent
blockers.evidence: Provider, merchant approval, test/live keys and integration are absent.
blockers.unblock: Choose a suitable provider, implement and test sandbox/webhooks, then arrange an explicitly authorised live test and reconciliation.

blockers.title: Custom domain and DNS inputs absent
blockers.evidence: No chosen owned domain or authorised DNS management context.
blockers.unblock: Provide chosen domain/DNS context and validate certificates; staging can use an AWS-generated hostname.

blockers.title: Traffic and spending bounds undefined
blockers.evidence: No verified target-account estimate, traffic model or budget.
blockers.unblock: Estimate compute/database/CDN/egress costs and define tested quota/worker/cost controls before provisioning and public access.

blockers.title: Permitted source use and market scope unresolved
blockers.evidence: Authorisations and supported-market review not established; YouTube terms restrict download and automated use.
blockers.unblock: Confirm the allowed workflow and relevant source/rights-holder permissions; complete appropriate public terms, privacy, support and complaint handling.

blockers.title: Terraform provider execution unavailable here
blockers.evidence: Official Terraform 1.17.0 and AWS provider 6.70.0 installed; fmt passes; provider listen unix socket fails operation not permitted.
blockers.unblock: Run the prepared locked-provider validate/mock jobs on a normal CI runner, then fix any real provider/API errors before plan/apply.
blockers.owner: Runner executes; assistant owns any source fixes

blockers.title: Production sender and notification delivery unverified
blockers.evidence: SES/outbox and alarm source exist; no verified account sender/production access, inbox or alert delivery is recorded.
blockers.unblock: Owner confirms sender/alert recipient and SES production access; runner verifies actual email and alarm delivery.

blockers.title: Public operator/contact/policy commitments pending
blockers.scope: Public support, legal identity and retention commitments
blockers.evidence: Concrete defaults, private-beta policy/help pages and operator enrollment exist; no public operator identity/contact/response commitment approval.
blockers.unblock: Owner supplies public identity/contact and approves final policy/support/market commitments before opening registration.

blockers.title: Post-launch observation requires a live capped beta
blockers.evidence: Observation collector/checklist are prepared; the application is not deployed on AWS and no real beta traffic/cost window has elapsed.
blockers.unblock: First close release gates and operate the capped beta; then gather actual launch/1h/24h/7d evidence.
